decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 13th June 2006, an erection of a roof extension with rear dormer window and the installation of three roof lights in the front roof plane with has the volume of 26.11m3, as shown on drawing numbers 6552-01, received 13th June 2006, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed erection of a roof extension with rear dormer window and the installation of three roof lights in the front roof plane, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Classes B and C of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
Condition : 2 - The proposed roof extension must not be higher than any part of the existing ridge of the roof. The original ridgeline and ridge capping of the house should be maintained.
Condition : 3 - The roof lights hereby permitted shall be flush with the existing plane of the roof.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a rear roof extension with roof windows to front elevation of house
